profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Microsoft | Full-Stack Development
profile.summary:
Experienced Full Stack Software Engineer currently working on Cloud Supply Chain Provisioning at Microsoft. Previously worked at Boeing.

I graduated from the University of Washington with a B.S. in Electrical and Computer Engineering in June 2023.

Throughout my academic journey, I honed my full-stack skillset by developing personal and professional projects in SWE, Web Development, AutoCAD, Electrical Engineering, and Computer Architecture.

I also worked as an educator, providing equitable and thoughtful instruction strengthening students' analytical and programming skills. 

My background in teaching and continual learning of technical concepts gives me a strong framework for swiftly mastering complex ideas, navigating ambiguous situations, and growing those around me.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - 777X Program
positions.description:
- Developed an AngularJS application with Java Spring Maven backend and AWS Neptune Graph database to replace a legacy aircraft database.
- Deployed a desktop application with Azure DevOps and containerized SQL relational database with background services in C# to assist PM’s in generating employee data and problem reporting artifacts.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · DO-178C · Python (Programming Language) · Certification · Requirements Analysis · C#

company.name: Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering

positions.title: CSE 122 Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Formerly CSE 14x, I am part of the first cohort of 12x TAs for the restructured Java curriculum at the University of Washington. 
Developing new instructional material using modern approaches to education. Leading an introductory Java section, instructing students on intermediate concepts, including object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and code quality conventions.

positions.title: CSE 143 Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Led an introductory Java section instructing students on intermediate concepts including object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and code quality conventions.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
▪ Optimized execution times for the 777X airplane’s Central Maintenance Display (CMD) via implementing minimum intrusion techniques such as using the C linker stage to "link" independently compiled modules.
▪ Worked collaboratively with systems and software engineers in both lab and office to create cross-platform data transformation scripts, resolve problem reports in legacy and third-party software, execute controlled lab procedures, and to modernize legacy programs.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · C (Programming Language) · Software Documentation · Python (Programming Language) · Git · ARINC 653 · Batch Programming · Jira · Visual Studio · Software Development · Agile Methodologies
